description: This file is a PHP script implementing a test client for the TestLink API. It constructs test result data and makes XML-RPC calls to report test case results, including handling different timestamp formats and overwriting previous results.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard PHP generic class used for creating context and execution objects.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: External class used for making XML-RPC client requests (assumed to be included elsewhere).

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: Debugging utility class for dumping variable information (assumed to be included elsewhere).

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Constructs and sends a report of a test case result to the server via XML-RPC, with various parameters including timestamp and overwrite flag.
